usage: Used as a noun meaning a light colour. 呢件衫係淺色。
Can describe clothes, furniture, or paint. 我想要淺色嘅牆身。
Often contrasts with 深色. 呢隻袋有淺色同深色兩款。
Common in everyday shopping and design talk. 你鍾意淺色定深色？
